<template>
  <v-container fluid>
    <v-card class="mb-4">
      <v-card-text>
        <v-row align="center">
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedAssetTypes"
              :items="assetTypes"
              label="Asset Types"
              multiple
              chips
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedBroker"
              :items="brokers"
              label="Brokers"
              item-title="name"
              item-value="id"
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-select
              v-model="selectedSecurities"
              :items="securities"
              label="Securities"
              multiple
              chips
              item-title="name"
              item-value="id"
              dense
            ></v-select>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-text-field
              v-model="startDate"
              label="Start Date"
              type="date"
              dense
            ></v-text-field>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-text-field
              v-model="endDate"
              label="End Date"
              type="date"
              dense
            ></v-text-field>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" sm="6" md="2">
            <v-btn color="primary" @click="applyFilters" block>
              Apply Filters
            </v-btn>
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>

    <v-card>
      <v-card-text>
        <v-row align="center" justify="space-between">
          <v-col cols="auto">
            <v-row>
              <v-col cols="auto">
                <AddSecurityButton />
              </v-col>
              <v-col cols="auto">
                <AddPriceEntryButton />
              </v-col>
            </v-row>
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="auto">
            <v-btn color="success" @click="showImportModal">
              Import Prices
            </v-btn>
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-card-text>
    </v-card>

    <!-- Price data table will be added here -->
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { getAssetTypes, getBrokers, getSecurities } from '@/services/api';
import AddSecurityButton from '@/components/buttons/AddSecurity.vue';
import AddPriceEntryButton from '@/components/buttons/AddPrice.vue';

export default {
  name: 'PricesPage',
  components: {
    AddSecurityButton,
    AddPriceEntryButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const assetTypes = ref([]);
    const brokers = ref([]);
    const securities = ref([]);
    const selectedAssetTypes = ref([]);
    const selectedBroker = ref(null);
    const selectedSecurities = ref([]);
    const startDate = ref('');
    const endDate = ref('');

    const loading = ref(false);
    const priceData = ref([]);
    const totalItems = ref(0);
    const itemsPerPage = ref(10);
    const editDialog = ref(false);
    const deleteDialog = ref(false);
    const editedItem = ref({});
    const deletedItem = ref({});

    const headers = [
      { title: 'Date', key: 'date' },
      { title: 'Security', key: 'security' },
      { title: 'Asset Type', key: 'asset_type' },
      { title: 'Currency', key: 'currency' },
      { title: 'Price', key: 'price' },
      { title: 'Actions', key: 'actions', sortable: false },
    ];

    onMounted(async () => {
      try {
        assetTypes.value = await getAssetTypes();
        brokers.value = await getBrokers();
        securities.value = await getSecurities();
        await fetchPriceData();
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching initial data:', error);
      }
    });

    const applyFilters = () => {
      fetchPriceData();
    };

    const showImportModal = () => {
      // TODO: Implement import modal logic
      console.log('Showing import modal');
    };

    const fetchPriceData = async () => {
      loading.value = true;
      try {
        // TODO: Implement actual API call
        // For now, we'll use dummy data
        priceData.value = [
          { id: 1, date: '2023-05-01', security: 'AAPL', asset_type: 'Stock', currency: 'USD', price: 150.25 },
          { id: 2, date: '2023-05-01', security: 'GOOGL', asset_type: 'Stock', currency: 'USD', price: 2150.75 },
          // Add more dummy data as needed
        ];
        totalItems.value = priceData.value.length;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching price data:', error);
      } finally {
        loading.value = false;
      }
    };

    const handleTableUpdate = (options) => {
      console.log('Table options updated:', options);
      // TODO: Implement server-side sorting and pagination
      fetchPriceData();
    };

    const editPrice = (item) => {
      editedItem.value = { ...item };
      editDialog.value = true;
    };

    const closeEditDialog = () => {
      editDialog.value = false;
      editedItem.value = {};
    };

    const updatePrice = async () => {
      // TODO: Implement actual API call to update price
      console.log('Updating price:', editedItem.value);
      closeEditDialog();
      await fetchPriceData();
    };

    const deletePrice = (item) => {
      deletedItem.value = item;
      deleteDialog.value = true;
    };

    const closeDeleteDialog = () => {
      deleteDialog.value = false;
      deletedItem.value = {};
    };

    const confirmDelete = async () => {
      // TODO: Implement actual API call to delete price
      console.log('Deleting price:', deletedItem.value);
      closeDeleteDialog();
      await fetchPriceData();
    };

    return {
      assetTypes,
      brokers,
      securities,
      selectedAssetTypes,
      selectedBroker,
      selectedSecurities,
      startDate,
      endDate,
      applyFilters,
      showImportModal,
      headers,
      priceData,
      loading,
      totalItems,
      itemsPerPage,
      editDialog,
      deleteDialog,
      editedItem,
      handleTableUpdate,
      editPrice,
      closeEditDialog,
      updatePrice,
      deletePrice,
      closeDeleteDialog,
      confirmDelete,
    };
  },
};
</script>
